focus: GenStep_DungeonLayout: AssignUses/Interior/Touches, FurnishRoom (BaseGen interior_* with null faction during a GenStep), Ruin (Sketch + SketchResolverDefOf placers, placeholder walls stripped, Sketch.Spawn at IntVec3.Zero Unchanged), powered wall def with CompPowerPlant and no ticker. Check for runtime errors, not style.
diffSource: since build 28 (2026-10-10T01:17:32Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Furnished rooms can log BaseGen 'Could not find any RuleDef for symbol' warnings
findings.detail: interior_barracks and interior_brewery add a heater or passive cooler by outdoor temperature, plus a lamp, as edgeThing; interior_diningRoom adds 1+ Table2x2c as thing. When no resolver's CanResolve finds room for one of those pieces, BaseGen.Resolve logs a Warning and skips that symbol. The minimum room is a 5x5 interior already filled with beds or barrels, so this can happen once per piece per map. In FurnishRoom, raise the minimum interior for Brewery and DiningRoom (e.g. 6x6), or test with forceFurnished on cold and hot tiles and read the log.

findings.title: Ruin furniture stuff is filtered by the world's rock types, not the dungeon's
findings.detail: useOnlyStonesAvailableOnMap only removes stones that aren't in Find.World.NaturalRockTypesIn(map.Tile). The walls use DungeonThemeUtility.RocksFor(tile). Steles, sarcophagi and urns can therefore be a different stone from the walls. Because allowWood=false only excludes WoodLog, sarcophagi and urns can also be metal. That contradicts the comment 'all in the tile's stone'. To match the walls, set q.wallEdgeThing etc. and add the stuff yourself, or check the stuff of what was spawned. Not an error.

findings.title: requireFloor only counts layerable terrain, so some ruins stay bare
findings.detail: The placers accept a cell only if sketch.TerrainAt(x).layerable. Cells where builtFloorDrift applies, and rooms where CorrespondingTerrainDef returns null and the code falls back to rough.smoothedTerrain (smoothed natural stone, which is not layerable), get no steles, sarcophagi or urns. Ruin then returns early. This doesn't break anything, but the dressing silently drops out on those themes.

findings.title: Furnished-room power grows with the room's perimeter
findings.detail: Every wall cell within one cell (diagonals included) of the room's built cells gets 60 W from SetUpPowerVars. A 5x5 room has about 28 such walls, around 1.7 kW, and bigger rooms give more. Players can wire anything to it. This is a design choice, not a runtime fault.

findings.title: forceFurnished is a static that survives loading another save
findings.detail: Nothing resets DungeonDebugActions.forceFurnished on a new game or a load. It stays on until toggled again or the game restarts. That's fine for a test aid, but it should be removed before shipping.
